welcome.title: You wake on the grass
welcome.text: Move with W A S D and look with the mouse; the prompts by the crosshair show what E and the mouse buttons will do. Everything here is all there will ever be.

item_stone.title: A good stone
item_stone.text: Carry two stones, hold one and press E on top of the flat stone or a boulder to knap it into a sharp edge.

item_twig.title: Twigs
item_twig.text: Dry twigs catch fire easily: the bridge between tinder and real fuel. Keep a handful for your first fire.

item_clay.title: Clay!
item_clay.text: Raw clay is gritty. Knead it with a little water - press E with it on a flat surface or bare ground, near the pond - before you shape it.

item_fiber.title: Plant fiber
item_fiber.text: Two bundles twist into cordage: hold fiber and press E on a flat surface or bare ground. Three dry bundles also make tinder.

item_stone_head.title: A shaped head
item_stone_head.text: Bind an axe head or digging blade to a stick with cordage to make a real tool: hold it and press E on a flat surface.

item_blade.title: A cutting edge
item_blade.text: Your blade cuts grass and the tree's small branches, and carves wood. Hold LMB on what you want to cut.

item_grass.title: Cut grass
item_grass.text: Fresh grass is a green for the compost heap. Or lay it down in the sun and it cures into straw: tinder, thatch and bedding.

item_branch.title: A leafy branch
item_branch.text: Put it down (RMB) and hold LMB on it with your blade: two sticks, three twigs and some leaves.

item_earth.title: Earth
item_earth.text: Dug earth can be packed back into a hole, packed over a burning woodpile to make a charcoal mound, or daubed onto wattle walls.

item_pot.title: Your pottery
item_pot.text: Wet clay must dry completely before firing, or it bursts. Set it down somewhere out of the rain - under a roof is best.

item_seed_grain.title: Seeds
item_seed_grain.text: Till soil with a digging tool (hold RMB), then plant seeds in it (RMB). Or cook them with water into porridge.

item_tuber.title: Skyroot tuber
item_tuber.text: Edible raw, twice as filling roasted at a fire. Planted whole in tilled soil, one tuber grows several more.

item_food_scraps.title: Food scraps
item_food_scraps.text: What you eat returns to the island as scraps. Compost them to put the nutrients back into the soil.

clay_found.title: You've reached clay
clay_found.text: Under the thin topsoil by the pond lies clay. There is plenty, but it never comes back - dig thoughtfully.

water_first.title: Fresh water
water_first.text: Cupped hands carry only a mouthful. A fired clay vessel lets you carry water to your crops - and to yourself.

drying.title: Drying
drying.text: Wet pottery takes about a day to dry in warm, breezy air. Rain undoes it - keep it under a roof.

tilled.title: Tilled soil
tilled.text: Plant seeds or a whole tuber here (RMB while holding them). Water and compost keep the soil productive.

watering.title: Watering
watering.text: Water soaks into the soil around where you pour. Too much simply runs off toward the pond.

branch_cut.title: The tree regrows
branch_cut.text: Cut branches grow back from the tree's reserves - in about ten in-game hours at best. Fell the trunk and you'll wait days for a new tree.

tree_planted.title: A future tree
tree_planted.text: Tree seeds grow slowly from almost nothing. Water them in dry weather.

first_fire.title: Fire
first_fire.text: Fire needs fuel, heat and air. Small, dry fuel first, then bigger pieces. Too little air and it smolders.

charcoal_open.title: Opened too soon?
charcoal_open.text: If the mound is opened while it's hot, air rushes in and the charcoal burns away to ash. Let it cool first.

cold.title: You're getting cold
cold.text: Nights are cold up here. Sit by a fire, get out of the wind and under a roof, and stay dry.

building.title: Placing a frame
building.text: LMB sets the frame down, R or the wheel turns it, RMB leaves. Then bring the materials: hold each part and hold LMB on the frame.

frame_placed.title: A frame
frame_placed.text: Look at the frame to see what it needs next. Hold that item and hold LMB on the frame to fit it - anyone can help.

bed_built.title: A place to sleep
bed_built.text: Press E on the mat to lie down. It becomes the place you wake after misfortune, and when everyone is asleep the night passes quickly.

mound_sealed.title: Sealed in earth
mound_sealed.text: Poke a vent or two with a stick (RMB) and watch the smoke: white steam, then yellow-gray smoke, then thin blue. Seal it then, and let it cool.

pottery_start.title: Shaping clay
pottery_start.text: Drag down on the top to open a hollow, drag a wall up to raise it, and smooth it with RMB. Press Enter when you're happy with it.

compost_started.title: A compost heap
compost_started.text: Mix greens (leaves, grass, scraps) with about as much brown (straw, fiber) by weight. Keep it damp, and turn it with LMB now and then.

compost_ready.title: Compost is ready
compost_ready.text: A heap nearby has finished compost. Press E on it with empty hands to take some, then work it into the soil with RMB.

hungry.title: Hungry
hungry.text: Your Food bar is getting low. Berries, mushrooms and tubers can be eaten raw (LMB); a roasted tuber fills you twice as much.

thirsty.title: Thirsty
thirsty.text: Your Water bar is getting low. Look at the pond and press E to drink with cupped hands.

tired.title: Out of breath
tired.text: Your Stamina is spent. Stop sprinting for a few seconds and it comes back - more slowly if you are hungry, thirsty or cold.

hurt.title: You're hurt
hurt.text: Health comes back slowly while you are fed, watered and warm, and twice as fast asleep. Cooked food helps a little.

night.title: Night is falling
night.text: The night is long and cold. Get close to a fire with fuel to spare, or sleep on a mat under a roof.

rain.title: Rain
rain.text: Rain fills the pond and waters the soil - and soaks anything left out. Get unfired pottery under a roof.

edge.title: The edge
edge.text: Beyond the cliffs is the abyss: whatever falls is gone for good. Hold Ctrl to crouch - crouching, you won't walk off the edge.

item_torch.title: A burning stick
item_torch.text: It burns down in under two minutes. Touch it to dry tinder or kindling (LMB on the piece) to light a new fire.

item_stick.title: Sticks
item_stick.text: Tool handles, fire drill spindles, wattle rods and fuel. Lay one on the ground (RMB) and work it with a blade (LMB) to carve a hearth board.

item_hearth_board.title: A hearth board
item_hearth_board.text: Set it down where you want your fire, hold a second stick and press LMB on it to drill for fire. Have tinder in your pack.

item_pole.title: A pole
item_pole.text: Long and straight: the backbone of platforms, posts, walls, roofs and ladders.

item_limb.title: A large limb
item_limb.text: Lay it down and chop it up with the axe: two poles, sticks, firewood, twigs and leaves.

item_log.title: A log
item_log.text: Split it with an axe - LMB on the end, where you want it to split. Slabs struck off near one side become boards; small pieces become firewood.

item_wood_piece.title: Split wood
item_wood_piece.text: Keep splitting. Thin slabs at least 15 centimeters wide become boards; small pieces become firewood.

item_board.title: Rough boards
item_board.text: Six boards and two poles make a platform; two boards make a shelf.

item_firewood.title: Firewood
item_firewood.text: Burns long and hot once a fire is going, but won't catch from tinder alone. Let it dry in the open first: green wood smokes.

item_charred_wood.title: Charred wood
item_charred_wood.text: Half-burnt wood. It still burns, and it's halfway to charcoal - stack it into your next mound.

item_leaves.title: Leaves
item_leaves.text: Poor, smoky fuel but excellent compost: a green for the heap.

item_straw.title: Straw
item_straw.text: The best tinder there is. Also thatch for roofs, bedding for sleeping mats, and a brown for the compost heap.

item_cordage.title: Cordage
item_cordage.text: Binds stone heads to handles and holds buildings together. Most blueprints need some.

item_clay_prepared.title: Prepared clay
item_clay_prepared.text: Smooth and evenly damp. Press E with it on a flat surface or bare ground to shape a vessel.

item_compost.title: Compost
item_compost.text: Hold it, aim at soil and press RMB to work it in. It puts back the nutrients your crops took out.

item_ash.title: Ash
item_ash.text: The minerals of everything that burned. Work it into soil (RMB) as fertilizer.

item_charcoal.title: Charcoal
item_charcoal.text: Light, nearly smokeless, and twice the heat of wood: the fuel for a really hot fire.

item_potsherds.title: Potsherds
item_potsherds.text: Broken fired pottery. Around a firing pit it holds the heat in.

item_seed_fiber.title: Fiber grass seeds
item_seed_fiber.text: Plant them in tilled soil (RMB) to grow your own fiber grass.

item_seed_tree.title: A tree seed
item_seed_tree.text: Plant it on open soil (RMB), well away from other plants. With water and patience it becomes a new tree.

item_tuber_roasted.title: Roasted tuber
item_tuber_roasted.text: Twice as filling as raw, and cooked food heals a little. Eat it with LMB.

item_mushroom_roasted.title: Roasted mushroom
item_mushroom_roasted.text: Smoky, more filling than raw, and cooked food heals a little.

item_grain.title: A grain sheaf
item_grain.text: Hold it and press LMB to thresh it: ten seeds and a bundle of straw.

item_berries.title: Berries
item_berries.text: A little food and a little water. Eat them with LMB. The bush fruits again in a day or two if its soil stays damp.

item_mushroom.title: A mushroom
item_mushroom.text: Edible raw, better roasted at the edge of a fire.

item_axe.title: A stone axe
item_axe.text: Chops off the tree's big limbs, fells the trunk and splits logs. A well-knapped head and a tight binding wear slowly.

item_digger.title: A digging tool
item_digger.text: Digs earth and clay about three times faster than your hands, tills soil for planting (hold RMB) and turns compost.
